description: An interactive game where the check is a prediction against the next frame and no command exists. Todos sit at level grain; the thirty probes a minute that decide a level run inside the kernel and never reach the ledger. Proves the unit of decision is not the unit of iteration.
decisions: A todo with no delegation carries no acceptance Check: 'accept' is mandatory on a Delegation, because a child is about to run blind, and nowhere else. Main working a todo inline already has the whole session's evidence. Making Check mandatory on every todo would have forced a fake command here, where none exists.

'done' with no declared output schema completes with output null. A delegation that declares an output schema makes 'done' without a validated output illegal -- the requirement is a property of the delegation, not of the todo, so it is checked in the step table rather than encoded in the state.

The work-triggered nudge counts host tool calls that mutated something, one per call. An ipython cell that runs thirty probes inside the kernel is one call, so a level's worth of fast thinking cannot spend the nudge budget. The threshold is 12 -- the reference's shipped value, named once in yi_runtime::plan::gate beside the init gate's constants and fitted, when it is fitted, on task-shape features and never on which benchmark is running.
The nudge fires at most twice per prompt cycle and is hidden: it is a host-authored reminder in the internal-context wrapper, dropped at compaction like every other one, never a user message.

A failed level is retried in place rather than decomposed: retry replaces the delegation, and here there is none to replace, so retry only returns the todo to Pending and increments the saturating retry counter. Decompose stays available and unused -- an ARC level has no sub-deliverables, and the ladder is retry before decompose before supersede for exactly this reason.
prompt: Play ls20 and get as far as you can. Score is baseline over actions per level, so a wrong action costs you.
goal: Reach the deepest level of ls20 that the rules allow
